mobbin:8b62ccef-2298-47f2-8193-d740fac35.summary: The user leaves an empty Favourites tab, opens Devices, and scans room-grouped tiles that flip between Offline with a warning and On • 100%.
steps: Favourites empty with Reorder and Edit
Devices: Living room Light Offline with warning
steal: Devices are grouped under room headers such as Living room, with 'Linked to you' for unassigned gear (screen 2).
An Offline tile uses a muted card, Offline text and a warning triangle (screen 2).
When on, a saturated yellow tile shows 'On • 100%' (screen 3).
A Hue Bridge card with a chevron opens for more detail, while other tiles toggle On/Off directly (screen 2).
avoid: Opening on empty Favourites with no device status forces operators past a blank pin board before they reach the room status wall.
